items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: An old friend of mine, George Jones, a violin player, he died some time ago.

ctx.x: Do you remember anybody in particular who used to play in these? In Spanos or Savokas?
Spanos? Well, yes. An old friend of mine, George Jones, a violin player, he died some time ago. Yeah, George Jones, he died. Is that the same guy playing the bass violin?
